AgentState (TypedDict, extends LangChain AgentState)
user_message : str
user_id : str | None
language : str | None
selected_agents : list[knowledge | customer_support]
knowledge_result : str | None
customer_support_result : str | None
final_response : str | None
messages : list[AnyMessage]
The same schema drives the outer graph and the
support agent's inner loop - which is how user_id
reaches the tools without passing through the model.

div.div:
Refresh loop
The FastAPI lifespan starts refresh_periodically():
a full re-index every 24h. A failed refresh keeps the
previous index serving and the reason lands in
/api/health -> last_error.
